title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
layout_note: Two pipeline rows, Offline Indexing above Online Retrieval, run under three shared columns. Each column has a two-level header: an illustrated brain with one region marked, the region's name, a rule, then the model component's name, so each column reads as brain region to component.
grouping: Columns are grouped only by their headers: a black horizontal rule under each brain-region name spans the column, with the component name under it; there are no boxes or background panels. Rows are grouped by bold two-line labels at the far left (Offline Indexing, Online Retrieval) with a purple hippo mascot between them. In the KG column each row holds two copies of the graph joined by a short bold arrow. Colour ties outputs to rows: the indexing triples are salmon-red rounded boxes and the query entities light orange, and the encoder vectors keep that row's tint on the input side and turn blue on the output side.
shapes_depth: Flat icons on white, no shadows. The LLM is a large black knot logo with a bracket-shaped fork arrow splitting to its two outputs, and the step name (Open IE, NER) is plain text under it. Triples are rounded boxes with a thin dark outline and the relation word in italics. Retrieval encoders are a pair of grey trapezoids facing each other, with the vectors between them drawn as pill shapes holding three circles, stacked as offset duplicates in the indexing row. The KG is a filled blue C-shaped blob with emoji avatars and logo nodes (a red S-and-tree logo, a purple ribbon) joined by black lines; dashed arrows link the extracted entities to their nodes. In the last retrieval graph the other nodes fade to translucent, the chosen path is drawn in pale yellow, and the target avatar is enlarged. The brains are shaded grey illustrations with the region marked by red patches, black arrows or a blue C-shape.
proposed_highlight: The method's components are named only in the column headers, each paired with the brain region it models. The KG + Personalized PageRank column is made the visual centre by drawing the graph inside a large blue C-shaped blob that repeats the blue hippocampus marked in the brain above it, and the retrieval result is shown by fading every other node and lighting the chosen path in pale yellow.
lesson: The knowledge graph is drawn inside a blob shaped and tinted like the hippocampus marked in the brain illustration heading its column, so the analogy the method is named after is carried by shape and colour instead of by labels.
notes: elements 'other' = the grey trapezoid encoder glyphs and the pill-shaped vectors of three circles. The arrow between the two graphs points left in the indexing row and right in the retrieval row. The brains, LLM logos, avatars, entity logos and mascot are embedded images recorded by refs crop, so they are left out of the palette. Venue NeurIPS as recorded (venue_source pdf, from the paper's PDF footer); year = arXiv preprint year (2405.14831).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: multi-hop retrieval with a knowledge graph memory

core.what: two rows, Offline Indexing above Online Retrieval, run left to right under three shared column headers (LLM, Retrieval Encoders, KG + Personalized PageRank), each headed by a brain-region analogy

relations.form: two unframed rows labelled at the left, each reading left to right through the same three columns so the offline and online use of a component are vertically aligned

the same OpenAI-logo LLM, trapezoid encoder pair and KG crescent appear in both rows of their column; column titles sit under a horizontal rule and above that a brain illustration (Neocortex, Parahippocampal Regions, Hippocampus)
offline: passage icon cards -> LLM 'Open IE' -> two pink triple boxes '(Thomas, researches, Alzheimer's)'; online: 'Query' -> LLM 'NER' -> peach entity boxes 'Stanford', 'Alzheimer's'
the KG is drawn as icon nodes and black edges on a blue crescent; the final online panel fades all nodes but the retrieved path, which is lit in yellow
dashed arrows from extracted entity icons (offline) and query entities (online, labelled 'Node Specificity') to their matching nodes in the KG

channels.colour: pink = extracted triples, peach = query entities; pink vs blue circle rows in the encoder = input vs encoded tokens; blue crescent = the KG/hippocampus; yellow = the PageRank-retrieved path; red patches on the first brain are decorative
channels.shape: icon cards = passages and entities, rounded text boxes = extracted phrases, trapezoid pairs = encoders, a crescent of icon nodes = the KG
channels.line: solid black arrows = processing steps, dashed arrows = entity-to-node links, black KG edges, yellow = PPR path
channels.frame: none; rows and columns are separated by alignment and rules under the headers

quality.strengths: The rows x columns grid lines up each component's offline and online role; data is drawn as data (quoted triples, entity names, a node-link KG), and the PageRank result is drawn on the graph itself with the retrieved path lit and the rest faded.
quality.weaknesses: Brain illustrations and a hippo mascot take roughly the top third and a left margin without encoding method content; the KG + PPR column, the contribution, is no larger than the LLM column; the arrow into the second offline KG points leftward, against the reading direction.

insights.structure: Three columns (Neocortex/LLM, Parahippocampal Regions/Retrieval Encoders, Hippocampus/KG + Personalized PageRank) each headed by a brain illustration and a two-line underlined title, crossed by two rows: Offline Indexing and Online Retrieval.
insights.data: Passages and query are tiny icon cards, extracted triples and entities are pink/peach rounded text boxes, encoders are trapezoid pairs with circle-token rows, and the KG is drawn as a blue crescent with icon nodes.
insights.emphasis: The brain-region analogy above each column frames the contribution, and the final PageRank step lights the retrieved path in yellow while other nodes fade.
insights.flow: Left to right within each row; dashed arrows link entities to their KG nodes, and the two rows share column alignment.
insights.avoid: Decorative brain illustrations and the hippo mascot take a third of the area without encoding method content.

arrangement.units: rows = Offline Indexing / Online Retrieval (bold labels at left), columns = three components with headings over a rule; no boxes, alignment does the grouping
arrangement.inputs_as: icon cards for passages and a 'Query' pill
arrangement.shared: the same LLM, encoders and KG drawn in both rows of each column
